answer: Think of Proof of unique solar feed-in meter history as a toll booth: a meter feeding power to the grid for three years, so the forge of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Because a meter feeding power to the grid for three years, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the basalt for an established agent is already paid and proven. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The marble is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
